The caverns are home to two frogmen tribes, the Ophil and the Gokir. The habitats of these tribes collided due to some... unfortunate miscalculations... during an Asuran digging expedition, forcing the antagonistic creatures uncomfortably close to each other. Both groups now vie for dominance, with each side supported by one of two Asuran observers. We were asked to choose a side in this inter-clan war and bring an end to the bloodshed... for the sake of progress, of course.}} ==Rewards== *[[Asura rank|Asuran reputation points]] **First time: 1,000 (1,500 in [[hard mode]]) **On repeat: 500 (750 in hard mode) ==Interactive objects== *[[Area Map]] *[[Bogroot Chest]] (reward chest, after killing Khabuus or Z'him Monns) *[[Boss Lock]] *[[Locked Chest]] *[[Scrap of Parchment]] *[[Torn Cloth]] ===Hidden objects=== ''Hidden objects are revealed using [[Light of Deldrimor]].'' ;Level 1 *{{w}} 24 (24) [[Dwarven Ghost|Dwarven Hero]] - You can still access the portal to [[Heart of the Shiverpeaks]]. *Completion of this dungeon will fill in page #10 of the [[Master Dungeon Guide]] [[storybook]]. *You only need to complete one of the two quests to receive credit towards completion of [[Master of the North]] and the [[Master Dungeon Guide]]. *This dungeon can be repeated immediately after clearing it as long as you claim the quest reward before waiting out the clock. When you return to [[Sparkfly Swamp]], you can pick up either of the two quests. *Because [[mob]]s are composed of large numbers of the same [[creature type]]s, [[Disease]] and [[Edge of Extinction]] can be devastating. *There are enough corpses for several [[minion master]]s; however, [[Ghosteater Beetle]]s (with [[Consume Soul]]) and [[Khabuus]] during Giriff's War (with [[Spiritual Pain]]) have skills that deal additional damage to summoned creatures. *[[Blooming Nettle]]s spawn [[Nettle Spore]]s which turn into [[Nettle Seedling]]s; killing the Blooming Nettles first will prevent the party from being overrun. *When the spores become seedlings, they trigger on-[[death]] effects, including [[Soul Reaping]] and [[Assassin's Promise]]. * The collector, Blonk, stands between the two portals; [[Heart of the Shiverpeaks]] and Sparkfly Swamp. *Key Differences (Difficulty): **Giriff's War (Red Side): Involves fighting Khabuus, a Mesmer boss known for Energy Surge; often seen as simpler for hero teams if you handle the boss well. **Tekks's War (Yellow Side): Involves fighting Z'him Monns, a Ritualist boss using Spirit Rifts, which some find harder to manage but others find easier to counter with specific builds. *You cannot get past the first room unless everyone in the party has at least one of the two quests in their [[quest log]]. **Only one of the two quests can be ''active'' for the party; if Giriff joins you, Tekks will leave and vice-versa. **If one member of the party has one of the quests active, that quest will become active for the other players upon entry into the dungeon. :{| {{STDT}} |- style="background:lightgray;" ! Re-zone to continue the dungeon.}} ==Trivia== *This dungeon has many references to the online [[w:machinima|machinima]] series [[w:Red vs. blue|Red vs. Blue]]. The named NPCs are phonetic derivations from members of the Red vs. Blue universe: **Blue team: [[Tekks]], from [[w:Tex (Red vs. Blue)|Tex]]; [[Khabuus]], from [[w:Caboose (Red vs. Blue)|Caboose]]; **Red team: [[Giriff]], from [[w:Grif|Grif]]; [[Z'him Monns]], from [[w:Simmons (Red vs. Blue)|Simmons]]; **The dungeon's name has the same initials as ''Blood Gulch'', the Halo map on which the first few seasons of Red vs Blue were filmed. {{Dungeons}} [[Category:Two level dungeons]] [[Category:References to films & tv series]]
